$description: Theme recipes. Each theme is three pigments: a brand colour, a partner that goes with it, and a complement from across the colour wheel. scripts/theme.mjs turns a recipe into pigments, neutrals, roles and eight section paints, and darkens or lightens anything that would fail contrast. Run `node scripts/build-tokens.mjs` after editing. The first theme is the default.
